name: [👑 UPD] Lasso People Simulator
desc:
💥 use your trusty lasso to cause chaos and snatch people

(💻📱 you can play on any device)

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
- go through the portal to enter the arena
- equip your lasso tool
- click/tap to throw your lasso and again to pull in your lasso
- kill people for gold to buy better and more OP lassos

🏆 get a high kill count and an overpowered rare lasso

⭐ THANKS FOR PLAYING! (please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates)
